panda.name: Panda Studios (Sam Pura)
panda.about: Raw, dry multi-mic chromatic recordings (single velocity, ~6 round robins) from The Panda Studios, analysed exactly like the pro libraries.

toms.note: Tom notes on a drum tuning chart (as on Sam Pura's chart) sit an octave above the struck fundamental; toms glide down after the stick, so the note is read once it settles.
